title: A3-21 Synth Retention, Runaway Witness and Epistemic Reversal Graph
scope: Determine A3-21's relationship to other synths/androids before escape, what repeated runaway testimony changed in his model of self-determination, how he described synth personhood, and how this evidence extends the MS08 graph without retroactively mutating the published v2.5 parent.

authoritative_shipped_sources: MS08PreHarknessVoice dialogue used by Replicated Man holotapes
MS08NoteHarknessToZimmer / Self determination is not a malfunction used holotape
source_authority_boundary.cut_source_warning: A separate transcript object MS08NoteHarknessToZimmerText / FormID 0008F9B5 is marked cut content. It closely parallels the used holotape but is not needed to establish the core claims here.

pre_escape_role.institution: Synth Retention Bureau of the Commonwealth
pre_escape_role.zimmer_description: A3-21's duty was to hunt and capture other escaped androids.
pre_escape_role.a3_21_self_description: Before becoming Harkness, he states that he used to work for the Synth Retention Bureau.

harkness_post_violet_memory.observation: Every time A3-21 retrieved a runaway android, the runaway would fill his head with ideas about self-determination and freedom.

runaway_testimony_path.independence_boundary: The individual runaway speakers are not separately identified in the shipped evidence reviewed here; therefore their testimonies are preserved as repeated first-person recollection by A3-21, not promoted into an independently enumerated witness quorum.

a3_21_synth_personhood_position.important_semantic_result: A3-21 does not merely request a private exception for himself; he explicitly generalizes the issue to synths as a group.
a3_21_synth_personhood_position.claim_boundary: His group-level personhood statement does not prove that he organized, led or represented all synths.

self_interest_and_solidarity.confirmed_self_interest: A3-21/Harkness explicitly says he would be lying if he claimed purely selfless motives and describes fear and escape as his only option.
self_interest_and_solidarity.confirmed_solidarity: He nevertheless generalizes from his own case to synth personhood, freedom and the rights of other runaways.
self_interest_and_solidarity.anti_messiah_rule: Do not turn A3-21 into a self-declared savior or revolutionary leader; the shipped testimony is more restrained and therefore more evidentially useful.

identity_after_recall.fact: After Recall Code Violet, Harkness remembers the A3-21 lineage and the runaway-retrieval history.
identity_after_recall.choice: He can still choose Harkness as his present identity and protect Rivet City.
identity_after_recall.interpretation: Choosing Harkness after remembering A3-21 does not equal rejecting synth personhood; it demonstrates that provenance, group membership and present social identity are separable dimensions.

janus_governance_parallel.lesson: A system should permit testimony from the subjects of enforcement to revise the model used by the enforcement agent; otherwise authority becomes epistemically closed to the people most affected by its decisions.

anti_overfit_rules: Do not claim every captured runaway independently delivered identical testimony; the shipped evidence is A3-21's recollection of repeated encounters.
Do not claim A3-21 was the leader of a synth rebellion.
Do not claim his prediction of rebellion proves that a rebellion occurred in Fallout 3.
Do not equate choosing Harkness as a present identity with denying that A3-21 was a synth.
Do not use the cut transcript duplicate when the used shipped holotape/dialogue already establishes the claim.
Do not romanticize his Retention Bureau past; the key forensic fact is that he participated in forced return before revising his model.

ru: A3-21 не родился противником Retention: он сам возвращал беглых синтов системе.
Повторяющиеся слова тех, кого он ловил, стали данными, которые его старая модель больше не могла объяснить.
Он перешёл от предположения о malfunction к формуле: self-determination is not a malfunction.
Он говорит не только о себе — в shipped записи появляется us synths и требование относиться к синтам как к persons.
При этом он не делает из себя мессию: он прямо признаёт страх и личный мотив побега.
Сильнейшая дуга MS08 — охотник становится тем, за кем раньше охотился, потому что наконец признал свидетельства пойманных им беглецов.
en: A3-21 did not begin as an opponent of Retention; he personally returned runaway synths to the system.
Repeated testimony from the people he captured became evidence his old model could no longer absorb.
He moved from a malfunction model to the explicit position that self-determination is not a malfunction.
His claim is not purely individual: the shipped recording uses us synths and argues that synths should be treated as persons.
He does not cast himself as a messiah; he openly acknowledges fear and personal motives for escape.
MS08's strongest reversal is that the hunter becomes the kind of runaway he once hunted after accepting the testimony of those he returned.
